serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
For some reason we always come dead last. It’s still 5 minutes before the time.
Lady Annalie: Glad you could make it! Sorry, but we already started singing~
You: No problem.
Bot: How are you, Annalie?
Lady Annalie: Everything's fine. Been having some fun with Melissa here since we came much earlier than you two.
You: Should we come an hour earlier too next time?
#Annalie_Outside.face.pervy
Lady Annalie: Oh~ Are you jealous two girls had some quality time together without you~ What a bore~
Melissa: I came only 20 minutes earlier. Annalie was already here. I guess she’s a bigger loner than all of us combined. 
#Annalie_Outside.face.suprised
Lady Annalie: U-Unexpected personal attack?! Why are you being so harsh, Melissa? I even invited you to my shop!
Melissa: That's precisely why. You called my clothes ‘used up.’
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.SmileClosed+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy
Lady Annalie: Well~ that’s because they kinda are. If you come to my shop, I promise you a makeover of your lifetime!
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: Eh…
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: I have no money to spare on such things. 
Lady Annalie: Alright, alright. I will give you 50% off.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Melissa: No.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
Lady Annalie: T-Then how about 75% off?
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Melissa: No.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Lady Annalie: Please! Please! You gotta come to my shop, please!
Lady Annalie: I will give you the clothes for free!
#Annalie_Outside.face.smileEyeClosed
#Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm
Melissa: If it’s free, I will come.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Melissa: But I demand a changing room with a solid door and a lock.
Lady Annalie: That’s…{{wi}} That’s too far, even for you, Melissa. Why do you punish me like that?
Melissa: It was my final offer.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww
Lady Annalie: Fine. 
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
You: Are you two done? It’s time for the singing to start! You can talk in your free time.
#Annalie_Outside.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Sure, sure. Sorry about that.
Lady Annalie: So! Who wants to be the first?
Bot: There are already two songs in the queue. 
Melissa: These are probably ours.
Lady Annalie: Alright then, we will finish them quickly and then the stage is yours!
You: Ok, good luck with your songs!
Lady Annalie: I don’t need luck. I’m that good.
The next song in the queue is some anime opening. That’s for sure Annalie’s song.
Lady Annalie: Oh! It’s my turn. I will take just a quick sip of my slushie. I talked too much and my mouth is dry~
Lady Annalie: Ahem! Ahem!
Lady Annalie: Now a little voice exercise.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
Lady Annalie: La~ LA~ La~ La~~~
You: …
#Annalie_Outside.face.sad
You: After this much preparation, if your singing won’t blow us away, I will be disappointed…
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open
Lady Annalie: I can sense your skepticism, but no matter! I WILL blow you away!
Lady Annalie: Here I go!
